Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Transition BPS Transition to ELM AI Basic Payment Scheme progressive reduction tracking (2021–2027 delinked payments). Delinked payment calculator for all claim years. Lump sum exit scheme eligibility verification. ELM readiness assessment for transitioning farmers. BPS entitlement value erosion modelling. SFI pilot to live transition support. Countryside Stewardship overlap analysis. Payment convergence planning across ELM tiers. Geospatial Land Parcel Verification AI Rural Land Register (RLR) parcel boundary validation. Digital aerial photography cross-match against declared parcels. Land cover classification from satellite imagery (arable, grass, moorland). Hedgerow and buffer strip verification. Permanent ineligible feature detection. Parcel split and merge tracking across claim years. Common land and shared grazing allocation. Landlord-tenant parcel attribution verification. SFI SFI Scheme Management AI Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI) standards selection optimiser. SFI action-level compliance verification. SFI payment rate calculator (per hectare and per action). SFI quarterly declaration processing. SFI mid-tier and advanced tier progression tracking. SFI interoperability with CS and LM agreements. SFI early adoption incentive calculation. SFI scheme performance monitoring dashboard. Compliance Cross-Compliance Monitoring AI Good Agricultural and Environmental Condition (GAEC) standard verification. Statutory Management Requirement (SMR) compliance tracking. SMR and GAEC penalty calculation methodology. Inspection targeting risk model. Remote sensing evidence for cross-compliance breaches. Over-declaration of land area detection. Erosion and soil management GAEC assessment. Water buffer zone compliance verification. Payments Payment Processing AI BPS and SFI payment scheduling optimisation. Payment accuracy audit (over/under-declaration detection). Payment allocation across multiple claim schemes. Bank detail verification and fraud prevention. Payment notification and transparency dashboard. Advance payment eligibility for SFI entrants. Payment reconciliation across financial years. Error and penalty deduction transparency reporting. Fraud Fraud Detection AI Farmers or agents with fraudulent land area claims detection. Phantom land parcel identification via satellite verification. Multiple claimant on same parcel anomaly detection. Agent submission irregularity pattern analysis. Beneficial ownership cross-check against Companies House. SFI action compliance spot-check targeting. Delinked payment uplift manipulation detection. Proportionate investigation with farmer right of reply. Geospatial Geospatial Verification AI High-resolution satellite imagery analysis for land use. LiDAR-based terrain modelling for moorland claims. Crop type classification from Sentinel-2 imagery. Hedgerow length and condition assessment from aerial photography. Watercourse buffer zone mapping. Woodland and tree cover verification. Stone wall and permanent boundary feature counting. Upland and common land boundary demarcation. Identity Farmer Digital Identity AI Single Business Account (SBA) identity verification. SBI (Single Business Identifier) lifecycle management. Agent authority and delegation verification. Land ownership and tenancy cross-match with Land Registr
